designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Every shared element in one place. Use this page to check tokens and components.

typography.body: Body text is used for descriptions and longer content. It stays calm so numbers and actions stand out.
typography.muted: Muted text is for hints, secondary details and timestamps.

cards.interactiveBody: Hover it: the border lightens, the glow grows and the card lifts by 2 px.
cards.staticBody: For content that is not clickable. Same surface, no hover.

dashboard.description: Your day at a glance: progress, next steps and what Jarvis noticed.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
